d:
我发现作者在换号后有部份作品未被上传至新号，且有部份重投作品从黑白条再加上了马赛克

于是我整理并将未重投部份放最前面，且将有薄码的作品替换为薄码，并照顺序完整合集

I noticed that after the artist changed accounts, some works were not reposted to the new account, while some reuploaded works had additional mosaic censorship added over the original black-and-white bars.

So I decided to organize everything, putting the unreuploaded works first, replacing the heavily censored versions with the lightly censored ones, and compiling the complete collection in the original order.
